_comment: Extra features for campaign 1 (release 5.5), merged by tools/crowdfunding_data.py on top of features.ods. A feature with the same first issue number replaces the row from features.ods.

features.name: Lower profiler overhead
features.what: The profiler slows down the measured code less

features.name: Correct PSQL line statistics in the profiler
features.what: Fix of wrong or missing PSQL line statistics

features.name: Remote profiler: fix of a concurrency problem
features.what: Reliable communication with the remote profiler

features.name: DECLARE VARIABLE with any value expression
EXPLAIN statement and RDB$SQL package
features.what: Show the plan of a query from SQL

features.name: Range-based FOR statement
features.what: FOR loop over a range of integer values in PSQL

features.name: USING statement
features.what: Run a query with parameters declared in the statement itself

features.name: Named parameters
features.what: Use :name parameters in queries

features.name: GEN_UUID can generate v7 UUID
features.what: Time-ordered UUIDs, good for primary keys

features.name: Local temporary tables
features.what: Temporary tables that exist only in one connection

features.name: CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT
features.what: Create and fill a table from a query

features.name: Named arguments
features.what: Named arguments for function calls, EXECUTE PROCEDURE and selectable procedures

features.name: DEFAULT keyword in argument list
features.what: Use the default value of a parameter in a call

features.name: CALL statement
features.what: Call a procedure or function with one statement

features.name: User-defined aggregate functions
features.what: Write your own aggregate functions

features.name: Frame EXCLUDE clause
features.what: Exclude the current row, group or ties from the window frame

features.name: GROUPS unit for window frames
features.what: Frame bounds counted in peer groups

features.name: Faster window functions with ORDER BY
features.what: Up to 1.8 times faster: the frame is not evaluated for functions that do not use it

features.name: Faster conversion of TIME WITH TIME ZONE to TIME
features.what: For example, CURRENT_TIME assigned to a TIME column: up to 4 times faster

features.name: Unix domain sockets
features.what: Fast local connections on Linux

features.name: gbak FAST_PATH mode
features.what: Faster backup and restore

features.name: Restore of Firebird 6 backups in Firebird 5.5
features.what: Downgrade compatibility

features.name: SET AUTOTERM in ISQL
features.what: No need to change the terminator for PSQL code
